correctness.rationale: For each mixed triple the two equal-side vertices are joined by a two-edge geodesic through the opposite vertex if indices differ, or one opposite same-index pair has distance three and a geodesic passing through the other selected same-side vertex. Pure-side sets cannot contain three vertices on a two-edge geodesic. Exact counting and maximality follow. Direct shortest-path exhaustive verifier agrees for n=3..8; finite enumeration is corroboration, not proof.
